cand.organizationName: Canadian Lyme Disease Foundation / U of T DFCM

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two relevant relationship contacts are Mary Keating, CanLyme board member with communications responsibilities, credited with organizing the inaugural conference; and Dr. Sarah Keating, CanLyme board member explicitly identified as a conference organizer. Their 2025 operational involvement is verified, but their 2027 housing responsibilities and signing authority are not. Request routing through the published conference@canlyme.com address; it is a shared event inbox, not a verified personal email.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed activity dates: April 17–18, 2027, at Vantage Venues, 150 King Street West, Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Registration is open. The organizer website, registration page and University of Toronto DFCM listing agree on the dates. This is within the requested horizon. No later officially announced edition was located; do not extrapolate April 2028 dates.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specifications: the 157-room Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown could pursue a modest subset of visiting delegates, speakers or students, rather than exclusive housing. More than 60 historical attendees is not a room count; local attendance and travel origins are unknown, so even a 15-room peak is not established. A city hotel is directionally appropriate for this downtown professional meeting; a resort-led pitch is not indicated. Meetings are already assigned to Vantage Venues. Future small meetings could be considered against the supplied approximately 240-theatre ballroom capacity only after requirements are known. Do not assume restaurant/lounge operation or catering capability.
findings.venueCommitments: The 2027 meeting venue is publicly confirmed as Vantage Venues, 150 King Street West, Toronto, Ontario, Canada. It is a downtown Toronto conference venue, not a hotel, not Harbourfront and not an MTCC or Exhibition Place booking. Public venue designation is verified; the underlying signed contract and release terms are not public.
findings.historicalRotation: The inaugural edition took place November 8–9, 2025 at Vantage Venues, 27th floor, 150 King Street West, Toronto, Ontario, Canada, with more than 60 attendees. The announced second edition returns to that venue April 17–18, 2027. No destination rotation is demonstrated. Although the organizer calls the series annual, the verified editions are in 2025 and 2027; no 2026 edition was established and a yearly cadence must not be inferred.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Edition-specific guidance directs attendees toward individual shopping: “We recommend using a reputable travel booking site to compare rates and find the best available pricing.” It explicitly states: “Please note that there are no conference rates at any of the hotels.” Every hotel listed is Union Hotel, Sheraton Centre, One King West, Cambridge Suites and DoubleTree by Hilton. These are recommendations, not verified host hotels, contracted blocks or guaranteed allocations. No housing bureau, open RFP, room-block quantity, peak rooms or room-night commitment was identified. Sourcing status remains unconfirmed, not open. Student grants of up to $1,000 toward travel and accommodation demonstrate support for some travel, not quantified room demand.
findings.organizationStructure: CanLyme / Canadian Lyme Disease Foundation is the event presenter and owner-side organizer: its historical listing names the foundation as organizer, and its website describes a volunteer-driven registered charity. Vantage Venues is the meeting venue. U of T DFCM publishes an event listing directing registration and questions to CanLyme; that listing does not establish DFCM as co-owner, contracting buyer or PCO. No separate PCO, DMC, agency or housing bureau was identified. The supplied travel-trade/intermediary segment is not supported by the evidence.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The five edition-specific recommended hotels have a visibility advantage: the organizer groups Union Hotel, Sheraton Centre and One King West within a ten-minute walk, and Cambridge Suites and DoubleTree by Hilton within an eleven-to-fifteen-minute walk. Radisson Blu is not on that published list. No contracted hotel exclusivity, sell-out, compression, unmet demand or overflow need was found. The current published meeting venue is an incumbent conference centre; hotel recommendations do not prove committed lodging.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Send one concise approach to conference@canlyme.com addressed to Mary Keating and Dr. Sarah Keating. Ask who manages 2027 speaker/student accommodation and the hotel recommendations page; whether any blocks or obligations exist outside the published guidance; and the expected non-local overnight delegates, arrival/departure dates and peak rooms. Offer a non-exclusive lodging option only if needed and ask permission to be considered for future editions. Do not pitch replacement of the confirmed 2027 venue or claim overflow. Verify the hotel’s current food-and-beverage provision internally before offering catered side meetings.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 lodging is not shown as contractually committed elsewhere, but neither is there an invitation to bid. The published pathway is attendee self-booking with no conference rates at the recommended hotels. A request to add a lodging option or discuss speaker accommodation is a plausible sales approach, not a verified procurement opportunity. The main conference venue is already confirmed elsewhere.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: cultivate the CanLyme organizing relationship for later lodging recommendations and possible future meeting-plus-rooms proposals. Repeat use of Vantage Venues creates an incumbent relationship to respect, not evidence of a future hotel RFP. No 2028 date, destination, venue search or rotation policy was established; any post-2027 capture remains conditional.
